title: gesneria pumila subsp. neglecta
intro: Gesneria pumila subsp. neglecta, commonly known as the "Pitaya" or "Dragon Fruit Cactus", is a succulent plant species known for its vibrant flowers and edible fruits. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Gesneria pumila subsp. neglecta are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
